flat_top.bound: zero rows in the top band a full rung below its own median

incident_free_top.bound: no connected region larger than 2px identical across the whole set

no_ring.bound: no tile with all four borders deviating >12% the same way

edge_agreement.bound: seam step <= 1.35x an ordinary interior step

constant_pitch.bound: <= 60% of the darkest columns on a tile boundary

cap_seamless.bound: cap seam <= 1.35x an interior step (the bar's is 4.44x)

cap_not_featureless.bound: at least the bar's 16.1 levels and no flatter than its 53.8% modal share

cap_field_scale.bound: drift sd >= 5 (the bar: 7..30) and no spike at the tile pitch
